# Arcmira

> Arcmira is an SF-based AI company and the search engine for the spoken web.

This repo and the `arcmira` npm package are the official TypeScript and JavaScript SDK plus the `arcmira` command line. The live agent index is on the website; fetch that first.

## Canonical

- [Site llms.txt](https://arcmira.com/llms.txt): Fetch this first. Product, API, citation rules.
- [Docs index](https://arcmira.com/docs/llms.txt): Catalog of every docs page.
- [API reference](https://arcmira.com/docs/api-reference): Every operation with curl samples.
- [OpenAPI](https://api.arcmira.com/v1/openapi.json): HTTP JSON contract at https://api.arcmira.com/v1
- [SDK reference](https://github.com/arcmira/arcmira/blob/master/reference.md): Every SDK method with its request and response types.
- [MCP server](https://github.com/arcmira/mcp): Remote MCP server at https://mcp.arcmira.com/mcp. For agents, prefer it over the SDK.
- [Arcmira MCP](https://arcmira.com/mcp): What the MCP server does.
- [Python SDK](https://github.com/arcmira/python): `pip install arcmira`.
- [Developers](https://arcmira.com/developers)
- [Homepage](https://arcmira.com)
- [Pricing](https://arcmira.com/pricing)
- [Contact](mailto:hi@arcmira.com): hi@arcmira.com

## Use

- Install: `npm install arcmira`. Key: `ARCMIRA_API_KEY` or `new ArcmiraClient({ apiKey })`.
- Client: `client.entities.resolve` (best, suggested or ask; reads take the ids it returns), `client.transcripts.search` (GET /v1/search), `client.transcripts.get` (a Premium read uses credits from the plan, then the on-demand budget, and answers pending on 202 until ready), `client.mentions.list` and `client.recommendations.list` (entity_id required, auto-paging), `client.entities.momentum`, `client.channels.sponsors.list`, `client.monitors.create`, `client.monitors.entities.add` (follow ids, or exact names with a type, in a monitor) and the rest, all in reference.md. Dated reads take `after` (inclusive) and `before` (exclusive).
- CLI: `npx arcmira setup` connects the MCP server and the Arcmira skills to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and Gemini CLI. `npx arcmira search "agent payments"`, `resolve` (`--context` for the user's words), `mentions`, `momentum`, `sponsors`, `recommendations`, `episodes`, `transcripts get|quote` (`transcript` is short for `transcripts get`), `occurrences`, `status`, `trackers create|list` (`follow` is short for `trackers create`, which takes `--monitor`), `monitors list|create|update|trackers|add|attach`, `integrations slack`, `login`, `logout`, `whoami`, `auth token`; any endpoint with `arcmira api GET /v1/...` (gh api grammar, `--paginate`), its parameters with `arcmira schema <command|operationId>`, docs search with `arcmira docs <query>`, worked tasks with `arcmira examples`. Filters take ids (`ent_`, `UC`); a name exits 2 with the resolve command. `--json` for the raw response, errors as JSON on stderr; exit 2 on bad input, 1 on API errors, 4 while Premium transcribes.
- Errors: typed classes under the `Arcmira` namespace with `err.body.error` (`type`, `code`, `gate`, `unlock.url`, `details.quote`).
